profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is recorded as a non-profit university lab. Its listed website is github.com. The text harvested from that address is GitHub's own description of itself, as a widely adopted AI-powered developer platform where developers, businesses, and open source communities build software, and it does not describe the vLLM team specifically.

The one product tracked for the team is vLLM, described as a high-throughput inference engine that is open source and self-hosted, with no external data sharing. Its listed location is the vllm-project/vllm repository on GitHub.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no other corporate or patent records are held for this entry.
